headline: Approved open police officer recruitment until June 30th, 2027, and waived written test for certified officers.
summary: Sergeant M. White asked the commission to waive the written test for certified police officers and to allow ongoing open recruitment for police officers. The commission approved both requests unanimously. The commission also approved job applications, eligibility lists, and requests to fill fire department positions.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the 10.08.2026 special meeting unanimously.
Accepted the Firefighter EMT and Firefighter Paramedic requests to fill unanimously.
Accepted seventeen Maintainer I applications unanimously.
Accepted nine Deputy Fire Marshal applications unanimously.
Approved eligibility list # 26-24 for Branch Library Manager unanimously.
Approved eligibility list # 26-25 for Library Technical Assistant unanimously.
Approved waiving the written test for certified police officers unanimously.
Approved open recruitment for certified and entry level police officers until June 30th, 2027, unanimously.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Civil Service Commission Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
9:00 AM, October 20, 2026 
 
 
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
  
 9:07 a.m. 
2. ATTENDANCE 
  
 Commissioners in attendance: Curt Andrews, Helen Ward, Andrea Lobo 
Staff in attendance: Ken Kelley, Lee Palmer, J. Susy Diaz-Callands. 
Police officers: M. White, R. Cotto, R. Manfield, and V. Palma 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
  
 
 
  1. Review and approval of the 10.08.2026 CSC Special Meeting Minutes  
  
• Commissioner Ward motioned to approve the 10.08.2026 special meeting 
minutes.  
• Commissioner Lobo seconded the motion 
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT 
  
 None.  
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
  
 None.  
6. ACTION ITEMS 
  
 
 
 1. Request to Fill:
1. Firefighter EMT  
  
• Commissioner Ward motioned to accept both Firefighter EMT and Firefighter 
Paramedic Requests To Fill. 
• Commissioner Lobo seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously. 
 
  2. Firefighter Paramedic   
  
• Commissioner Ward motioned to accept both Firefighter EMT and Firefighter 
Paramedic Requests To Fill. 
• Commissioner Lobo seconded the motion.  
• Motion passes unanimously. 
  
 2. Review and approval of the following job applications: 
       
  
 
  1. Maintainer I   
  
• Commissioner Lobo motioned to accept seventeen (17) Maintainer 
applications. 
• Commissioner Ward seconded the motion.  
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
  2. Deputy Fire Marshal   
  
• Commissioner Andrews motioned to accept nine (9) Deputy Fire Marshal 
applications. 
• Commissioner Ward seconded the motion.  
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
 3. Certification of the following eligibility lists: 
       
  
 
  1. List # 26-24 Branch Library Manager, which was tabled at the 10.08.2026 CSC 
Special Meeting   
  
• Commissioner Ward motioned to approve List # 26-24 Branch Library 
Manager. 
• Commissioner Lobo seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
  2. List # 26-25 Library Technical Assistant
• Commissioner Lobo motioned to approve List # 26-25 Library Technical 
Assistant.  
• Commissioner Ward seconded the motion.  
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
7. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 None. 
8. REPORTS 
  
 None. 
9. OLD BUSINESS 
  
 None.  
10. NEW BUSINESS 
  
 Sergeant M. White spoke on behalf of Police Chief E.P. Reynolds- asking the commission 
to allow for the police department to do away with a written examination for certified police 
officers. He also asked for ongoing open recruitment for entry level police officers and 
certified police officers.  
 
• Commissioner Andrews motioned to wave written test for certified police officers. 
• Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously. 
 
 
• Commissioner Andrews motioned to allow open recruitment  for certified and entry 
level police officers until June 30th, 2027. 
• Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
  
11. ADJOURNMENT 
  
 
• Commissioner Lobo motioned to adjourn. 
• Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
• Motion passed unanimously, meeting adjourned at 9:26 a.m.
